title.zh: 次数怎样连接这份象征说明
title.en: How counts connect to this symbolic guide

paragraphs.zh: 18题每次只给所选路径加1，六条路径各出现12次、在每个位置各3次；0反向，计数总和18。分母12表示可选择次数，不是性格或来世概率。所有最高并列都保留全文，全选A会六项各3，不派主副型，也不认证平衡。较少选择不说明缺少这条路代表的东西；菜单、当时向往与现实条件都可能影响选择，一次差异不证明稳定改变。
paragraphs.en: Each of eighteen choices adds one count to its selected path. Six paths each appear twelve times, three in each position, with no reversals and eighteen total counts. Twelve is exposure, not a personality share or afterlife probability. All highest ties retain full guides; all A gives three each without primary or secondary types or certified balance. Fewer selections establish no missing resource. Menus, current wishes and circumstances may affect choices; a difference establishes no stable change.

title.zh: 把想离开与想接触的新事物分开
title.en: Separate wanting to leave from wanting a new encounter

paragraphs.zh: 回到上面的陌生街区，先想一个真正想了解的小细节，再问这个兴趣是否必须靠远行才能接触。可以只设想附近一条未走过的路，也可以保留熟悉环境。复盘关注向往的是体验、变化还是一段空白，不用实际出发、花钱或证明勇敢。若只喜欢想象新起点，也可以让它停留在故事里；这次选择不要求搬家、换工作或解释当前生活出了什么问题。
paragraphs.en: For the unfamiliar neighbourhood above, identify a detail you would actually like to understand and ask whether travel is needed to encounter it. Imagine a nearby unfamiliar route or retain familiar surroundings. Review whether experience, change or an unfilled interval appeals without departing, spending money or proving courage. Enjoying an imagined beginning can remain a story; no move, job change or explanation of what is wrong with current life is required.

title.en: Use the image as a conversation opening

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果新鲜感只需来自附近一条陌生路，你想了解什么，哪些熟悉的部分仍希望保留？”分享想在普通一周留出什么空间即可，不比较哪条人生更高等，也不把意象当来世事实、能力或职业建议。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a nearby unfamiliar route supplied novelty, what would you want to understand and what familiar parts would you retain?” Discuss room you would welcome in an ordinary week without ranking lives or treating an image as an afterlife fact, ability or career advice.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。对方可以换个意象、不回答或结束；不需解释信仰、收入或私人经历，也不用真的完成一次活动或再做测试来证明结果。
paragraphs.en: You can share this public guide; its link contains no answers or counts. The other person may choose another image, decline or stop without explaining beliefs, income or private experiences, completing an activity or taking another test to prove a result.

title.zh: 让回来的节奏也有暂停空间
title.en: Leave room to pause within a returning rhythm

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上面的窗边或固定小路，想想吸引你的是看见变化、熟悉感，还是少一点成果压力。可以只比较记忆中的两次观看，不必照料新的植物或开启打卡。若重复成了负担，可以缩小、共享或暂停。复盘不统计连续天数，也不以坚持证明耐心、环保或会照顾生命；园丁是一个可选意象，不是要求维持完美日常的身份。
paragraphs.en: For the window or familiar path above, consider whether noticing change, familiarity or less achievement pressure appeals. Compare two remembered views without caring for a new plant or starting a streak. Narrow, share or pause a burdensome routine. Review without counting consecutive days or proving patience, environmental virtue or care ability. Gardener remains an optional image rather than an identity requiring a perfect daily rhythm.

title.en: Use the image as a conversation opening

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果喜欢回到同一扇窗，什么变化值得留意，怎样让暂停或少看几次也不变成失败？”分享想在普通一周留出什么空间即可，不比较哪条人生更高等，也不把意象当来世事实、能力或职业建议。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If returning to a window appealed, what change might matter and how could pausing or missing visits remain free of failure?” Discuss room you would welcome in an ordinary week without ranking lives or treating an image as an afterlife fact, ability or career advice.

title.zh: 把想相处与愿意承担的准备分开
title.en: Separate desired company from preparation you would accept

paragraphs.zh: 回到上面的简单长桌，分别想想希望怎样相处、愿意承担哪一点准备，以及哪些工作需要共同分担。也可以只想象两人喝茶，不必发出邀请。复盘看是否有拒绝、结束和表达自己需要的空间，不用人数、热闹程度或别人是否需要你证明归属感。喜欢相聚不等于必须随时接待，也不由计数决定家庭或朋友圈里该由谁照料大家。
paragraphs.en: For the simple long table above, distinguish the company you want, preparation you would accept and work requiring a shared arrangement. Imagine tea for two without issuing an invitation. Review room to decline, end and express your needs without proving belonging through numbers, liveliness or being needed. Enjoying gatherings creates no duty of constant hospitality, and counts assign no caregiving role in a family or friendship group.

title.en: Use the image as a conversation opening

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只安排一次简短喝茶，你期待怎样的相处，准备与收尾如何分担，谁都能怎样拒绝？”分享想在普通一周留出什么空间即可，不比较哪条人生更高等，也不把意象当来世事实、能力或职业建议。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For a short tea together, what company would appeal, how might preparation and cleanup be shared and how could either person decline?” Discuss room you would welcome in an ordinary week without ranking lives or treating an image as an afterlife fact, ability or career advice.

title.zh: 区分参与过程、实际用途与停止条件
title.en: Distinguish the process, practical use and stopping conditions

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上面的低风险纸夹或收纳标签，先想想吸引你的是弄清原理、尝试改动，还是让物品更好用。可以只在纸上设想一种可撤回的变化，再说明什么情况会停止。真实制作仍需合适知识与条件，不用为了符合工匠意象动手。复盘不以修好多少、替代购买或技术熟练证明价值；寻求帮助、换一个办法或不继续都可以。
paragraphs.en: For the paper folder or storage label above, distinguish understanding, trying a change and usefulness. Imagine a reversible change on paper and name a stopping condition. Real making still needs suitable knowledge and conditions; no hands-on action must prove a Maker image. Review without counting repairs, avoiding purchases or demonstrating skill as proof of worth. Help, another approach and stopping remain available.

title.en: Use the image as a conversation opening

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只改善一个收纳标签，你想了解过程还是实际用途，哪些条件会让你选择停止或求助？”分享想在普通一周留出什么空间即可，不比较哪条人生更高等，也不把意象当来世事实、能力或职业建议。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For one storage label, would the process or actual use appeal, and what conditions would lead you to stop or seek help?” Discuss room you would welcome in an ordinary week without ranking lives or treating an image as an afterlife fact, ability or career advice.

title.zh: 给一段表达标明选择与留白
title.en: Name the selection and omissions in an expression

paragraphs.zh: 回到上面的街角细节，选一句私人草稿想保留什么，再指出它无法代表的部分。可以只描写光线或门的形状，不需要记录可识别的人或公开作品。复盘关注表达想传达的内容与留下的空白，不用观众反应、记忆准确或创作天赋证明记录者身份。什么也没做也不让一天失去意义，想分享前仍需尊重相关人的意愿。
paragraphs.en: For the street-corner detail above, identify what one private sentence would retain and what it cannot represent. Describe light or a doorway without recording identifiable people or publishing work. Review intended meaning and omissions without proving a Chronicler identity through audience response, memory accuracy or artistic talent. Producing nothing does not remove a day’s value, and sharing still requires respect for the people involved.

title.en: Use the image as a conversation opening

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果用两句话写一个非私密的街角细节，你希望留下什么，哪些部分只是取景，哪些不宜替别人讲？”分享想在普通一周留出什么空间即可，不比较哪条人生更高等，也不把意象当来世事实、能力或职业建议。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “In two sentences about a non-private street detail, what would you retain, what would be framing and what would not be yours to tell?” Discuss room you would welcome in an ordinary week without ranking lives or treating an image as an afterlife fact, ability or career advice.

title.zh: 把想弄清的问题与暂停点并列
title.en: Place the question beside a stopping point

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上面的解释与小例子不符，先区分已知的差异、两种可能解释和还缺的证据。可以只写一个问号，并决定这次了解到哪里就停；不必展开完整研究。复盘关注获得了什么依据、仍有什么未知，不以搜索时长、答案巧妙或反复重测证明聪明。问题可以开放，休息与转向其他事情也可以，夜窗不是牺牲睡眠或一直查下去的要求。
paragraphs.en: For the explanation that did not fit a small example above, distinguish the mismatch, two possible accounts and missing evidence. Keep one question mark and decide where to pause without a full investigation. Review support and unknowns without proving intelligence through search time, clever answers or repeated quizzes. A question may stay open alongside rest and other activities; the night window requires neither lost sleep nor endless checking.

title.en: Use the image as a conversation opening

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一个小例子不符合原解释，什么已经知道，哪两种解释仍可能成立，这次准备在哪里暂停？”分享想在普通一周留出什么空间即可，不比较哪条人生更高等，也不把意象当来世事实、能力或职业建议。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a small example did not fit an explanation, what would be known, which two accounts might remain possible and where would you pause?” Discuss room you would welcome in an ordinary week without ranking lives or treating an image as an afterlife fact, ability or career advice.
